title: Patriot South 2020: Search and Rescue
description: Mississippi Task Force Urban Search and Rescue trains with Air and Army National Guard members during Patriot South 2020 at the Guardian Centers in Perry, Georgia, Feb. 29, 2020. PATRIOT is a Domestic Operations disaster-response training exercise conducted by National Guard units working with federal, state and local emergency management agencies, and first responders.

transcript.text: - [Narrator] Mississippi Task Force Urban Search and Rescue
trains with Air and Army National Guard members
at the Guardian Centers in Perry, Georgia
during Patriot South 2020.
- [Brad] By coming here to this Guardian Center location
and working together with National Guard unit guys
we find different techniques from National Guard guys,
as well as, they do with us.
- [Narrator] Patriot is a training exercise designed
to give civilian and military organizations the opportunity
to realistically train together
in a way that replicates real world natural disasters.
The scenario today is a collapsed building
where search and rescue teams must find mock victims
and dig them out of the rubble.
- [Brad] Working with those states
and other organizations are definitely very interesting.
Everybody has their own way, their own personalities,
their own techniques, their own designs of issues
and the way they handle issues,
but at the end of the day we're all here for the same thing
and that's to help someone out and to keep each other safe.
